task: external validation of colorectal KRAS-from-H&E, microsatellite-stable only
model: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.01, class_weight='balanced', max_iter=2000) on mean-pooled tile features
training_set: TCGA colorectal dev partition, MSS mutation cohort, mut_labels.csv crc_KRAS, 324 slides (136 mutant / 188 wild-type); fit on all dev, no fold held out
external_set: SurGen SR386, the 126 slides already embedded (surgen_msi_external_scores.csv), restricted to mmr_loss_binary==0 and KRAS status determinate on ALL THREE assays in SR386_labels_v02.csv
external_label_rule: mutant if any of kras_ex_2, kras_ex_3, kras_codon_117 starts with 'M'; wild-type only if ALL THREE are 'WT'; otherwise excluded (a 'FAIL' on any assay with no mutation elsewhere is indeterminate, not wild-type)
primary_metric: slide-level AUROC with 1000-sample bootstrap 95% CI, seed 0
confounder_check: n_tissue_tiles alone as a predictor of KRAS status
looks: one; result logged as a deviation in preregistration.md and not re-run with another recipe
caveat: MMR by IHC in SurGen vs MANTIS>=0.4 in TCGA; SurGen 0.1112 um/px resampled to the pipeline's 0.5 um/px tiles
supersedes: spec hash 418f482d36950b53, whose wild-type rule checked only kras_ex_2 and kras_ex_3 and so counted 3 codon-117-FAIL cases (327, 428, 551) as wild-type
